Staff Platform Engineer, Core Services

Cartwheel Commerce | Remote (US) | Full-time

About Cartwheel Commerce

Cartwheel Commerce is a commerce platform that helps merchants of every size start, run and grow their businesses, online and in person. Behind the storefronts are large backend systems for checkout, payments, orders, inventory and the APIs that thousands of apps and partners build on. Cartwheel Commerce is digital by design: most of the company works remotely, and we put a lot of care into written communication and async collaboration.

About the team

Core Services builds the internal platform that product teams use to ship and run backend services: service scaffolding, the deploy pipeline, event infrastructure, rate limiting and traffic management, and the guardrails that keep a large codebase healthy. A big part of our work right now is helping teams carve well-defined services out of large application code without slowing product work down, and making the services they end up with boring to operate.

The role

We're hiring a Staff Platform Engineer to set technical direction for parts of our service platform and to lead hands-on work that crosses team boundaries. This is an individual contributor role. You'll spend most of your time designing, building and reviewing, and part of it helping other teams succeed on the platform.

What you'll do

- Lead the design and build of platform capabilities for service extraction: patterns for splitting domains out of a monolith, data ownership, API contracts and safe incremental cutovers
- Improve the reliability and speed of the deploy path for hundreds of services
- Build and evolve shared infrastructure for event streaming, retries, idempotency and backpressure
- Own the design of distributed rate limiting and load shedding for internal and partner-facing APIs
- Write technical strategy documents and drive alignment across several teams
- Mentor senior engineers and help grow technical leaders on the team
- Take part in on-call for platform services and lead incident reviews that lead to real fixes

What you'll bring

- 10+ years of backend engineering experience, including several years at senior or staff level
- Experience leading a monolith-to-services migration or a similar large, incremental architecture change in a production system
- Strong skills in at least one of Go, Ruby, Java or Rust; experience with Ruby on Rails is a plus but not required
- Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, delivery guarantees, failure modes, rate limiting
- Hands-on experience with relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and message streaming (Kafka or similar)
- Experience running services on Kubernetes in a major cloud environment
- Excellent writing skills; at Cartwheel Commerce, a lot of decisions are made in documents

Nice to have

- Payments, billing or other financial systems experience
- Open-source work in infrastructure tooling
- Experience designing internal developer platforms or service templates

Compensation

The base salary range for this role in the US is $213,000 to $266,000. Final offers depend on experience and skills. In addition to base pay, Cartwheel Commerce offers equity and a flexible benefits plan, including health coverage, retirement savings and parental leave.

Location and travel

This role is fully remote for candidates based anywhere in the United States. We get together in person a few times a year for team and company events; total travel is typically under 10%.

Work authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role does not require a security clearance.

Cartwheel Commerce is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are happy to provide accommodations during the hiring process.
